details:
Allow PCVR players to use hand tracking via OSC, would allow quest/pico hand tracking potentially via ALXR/Virtual Desktop or Ultraleap devices to be used. (also hand tracking gloves without having to emulate index controllers)

I'd suggest the following adresses

/tracking/hand/leftposhmd

/tracking/hand/leftrothmd

/tracking/hand/rightposhmd

/tracking/hand/rightrothmd

/tracking/hand/leftposplayspace

/tracking/hand/leftrotplayspace

/tracking/hand/rightposplayspace

/tracking/hand/rightrotplayspace

/tracking/hand/leftthumb

/tracking/hand/leftindex

/tracking/hand/leftmiddle

/tracking/hand/leftring

/tracking/hand/leftpinky

/tracking/hand/rightthumb

/tracking/hand/rightindex

/tracking/hand/rightmiddle

/tracking/hand/rightring

/tracking/hand/rightpinky

fingers would be formatted as 4 floats per adress (siumlar to /tracking/eye/LeftRightPitchYaw), with the first 3 being curl and the 4th being splay
